_comment: History Content -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-12. Layout, numbering and spelling repairs only: NONE of these
rewrites a competence, an activity or an expected standard.
MATRIX NUMBERS. In Year 1 the topic and most sub-topic cells carry no number, and the
competence numbers are Word list numbers that run on across topics (1.1.1.4, 1.1.1.5
... 1.1.1.11 under Missionary Activities, Imperialism, Colonial Rule, the First World War
and World Peace; one more, 1.1.1.12, printed in the Expected Standard column in Year 2).
Year 2 numbers topic 2.1's sub-topics 2.1.1, 2.2.2, 2.2.3, 2.2.4. renumberMatrix counts
them all afresh from the table's structure. The result agrees with the manuscript's own
typed contents list (1.1 Concept of History, 1.4 The Origins of Man, 1.13.2 African
reaction to colonial rule ...).
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* ISBN: none given; the imprint shows a blank ISBN line.
* The Director's name is 'Charles Makala (Dr.)' here, 'Charles Ndakala (Dr.)' in the
Music Content and Music Methods syllabuses. Set as written.
* Year 2 Key Competences: several descriptors repeat or belong to Year 1 topics
(Collaboration and Communication both 'Promote collaboration among former
federation members'; Entrepreneurship and Financial Education both 'Relate Black
Friday to modern day commerce'). Set as written.
* Year 1 Key Competences: 'Citizenship' and 'Emotional Intelligence' share one
descriptor, as do 'Entrepreneurship' and 'Financial Education'. Set as written.

insertText._why: The copyright line 'Curriculum Development Centre, 2025' is styled as a heading straight after the cover headings (its (c) sign lost), and went with the cover. Set back above the rights notice, as in the other syllabuses.
insertText.before: All rights reserved. No part of this publication

setHeading._why: Section titles typed with a colon; without it Background opens its own page like the other top-level divisions, and none carries the colon into the contents.

_deleteExact_why: A 'Year 1' heading over the Year 1 Key Competences table, and the manuscript's own 'YEAR 1' again over the matrix: two YEAR 1 pages. The one over the matrix stays, as in Year 2 (competences, then the YEAR 2 page, then the matrix).

pageBreakBefore._why: The Year 2 competences table ran on half-way down the page under the last Year 1 row; it opens Year 2, as the Year 1 table opens Year 1.
pageBreakBefore.find: Competences to be developed at year two

edit._why: Dash as in the Acknowledgement's 'Director – Directorate of Curriculum Development'.

editCell._why: A Word list number (the run-on 1.1.1.x list, see _comment) printed at the head of an Expected Standard cell.
